erin.s: Heads-up — we discovered several developer machines and CI runners with long-lived service tokens cached by local credential helpers (docker, gcloud legacy creds, aws-cli). These tokens persist across backups and can be exfiltrated. We need an immediate audit + sanitization across all engineers. Deadline: EOD Wed UTC.
samir: Yikes. How widespread is this? Any IOCs to hunt for?
erin.s: Initial triage found ~12 flagged runners and ~30 dev home dirs. Indicators: presence of `~/.docker/config.json` with `credsStore` or auths, files under `~/.config/gcloud/legacy_credentials/*/`, and `~/.aws/credentials` containing prod/profile entries. Quick checks you can run locally:
```bash
# list likely risky files
find ~ -type f \( -path "*/.docker/config.json" -o -path "*/.config/gcloud/legacy_credentials/*" -o -path "*/.aws/credentials" \) -print
``` 
Please run the audit script (internal): https://redwood.internal/sec-scripts/dev-cred-audit.sh — it detects common helpers and prints exact remediation steps. Paste the script output into SEC-3245.
nina: Is this a mandatory rotate or just cleanup of local caches? Will sec trigger rotations for impacted keys?
erin.s: Action items: 1) Run the audit script and sanitize local stores (remove tokens/credential helpers) 2) Rotate any keys/secrets that were found in your output 3) Create or update a ticket in SEC-3245 with the scan output and remediation notes. Sec will do an org-wide automated scan tomorrow morning and rotate tokens in systems we control where necessary. Individual user-managed tokens must be rotated by the owner.
devon: Can we get an automated notification for folks who have flagged items? Might be hard to get everyone to run scripts.
ops-oncall: We're deploying a scanning job that will: 1) run an inventory on company-managed runners 2) DM affected users with remediation steps 3) optionally schedule forced expiration for tokens we can identify. ETA 48h for the DM flow.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-3245 and scheduled org scan for 2026-03-24 08:00 UTC. Reminder: this is a company-wide required action — please comply by deadline. @here
samir: Running the script now, will update SEC-3245. :thumbsup:
erin.s: If you cannot run the script (air-gapped laptop etc.) DM me. Quick remediation links: GCP key rotation console: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts , AWS: `aws iam` key rotation docs, Docker tokens: https://hub.docker.com/settings/security
When you're done, reply here with "done" and a ticket link. Thanks all for moving quickly on this.
